_comment: Container defaults for a bounded worker.
defaultTools restricts BUILT-IN tools only; an empty array still leaves
extension and SDK tools live, so this is a narrowing default and NOT a
boundary. The boundary is enforced by contract-guard at tool_call.
grep/find/ls are intentionally omitted: a weak model that cannot use them
tends to substitute `bash ls` / `bash grep`, which routes around path
guards. Whether that is real must be measured in brief 02, not assumed.
compaction.modelOverrides: keys are exact, case-sensitive provider/modelId
strings (pi's own compaction.md) - a typo'd key silently never matches, so
verify each one against a real session's message.provider/message.model
fields (scripts/session-cost.mjs) rather than trusting it from memory.
The GLOBAL reserveTokens/keepRecentTokens below are sized for small
context windows and do their job there - for a ~128K local model the
default trigger (contextWindow - reserveTokens = ~111K) fires with real
room to spare. They do NOT help on a huge-context model: a 256K-1M window
makes that same 16384 reserve so small a fraction that compaction may
never fire in a normal session - which is exactly what the real measured
sessions showed (cacheRead ~97% of total tokens, no visible reset point;
see docs/postmortems/LOG.md). So per big-context model: a LARGE
reserveTokens forces an early trigger despite the huge window (same
pattern pi's own docs example uses). Target: HARNESS_COMPACT_AT (default
200K, scripts/harness-config-lib.sh) - the same trigger Claude/Codex get.
Generated per catalog model by scripts/gen-compaction-overrides.mjs.
The four 'local/*' entries below are UNVERIFIED - added from names given
in conversation, not probed. This file's OWN models.json already carries
the exact same warning for a reason: 'Model names are not facts... do not
attribute a capability to a name without probing it.' Same rule applies
to the override KEY itself - if oMLX reports a different exact string
than one of these four, that entry silently never matches and this falls
back to the (too-generous-for-128K-sized-down-for-this, still-fine)
global default. Confirm each against a real local session's
message.provider/message.model (scripts/session-cost.mjs), or against
oMLX's own /v1/models, before trusting it actually applied.
Free/stealth cloud models (openrouter) rotate names and are added
add-as-they-appear, not pre-guessed: when session-cost.mjs shows a new
one, add it here as provider/modelId with reserveTokens = its reported
context window - 100000, same treatment space-bunny-alpha got.
